title: Time bound for pair component extraction
statement: For any two Boolean flags $f_1,f_2$ and every finite bit string $x$, the extractor computes within $5(|x|+1)$ steps the following output: if $x$ decodes as a pair $(a,b)$, it outputs $a$ when $f_1$ is true followed by $b$ when $f_2$ is true, omitting either component whose flag is false; if $x$ does not decode, it outputs the empty string.
